annotations.title: Find or queue an open match

description: Find or queue an open match. WHEN: find or queue an open match for a game (simple matchmaking). Differs from arena_join (instant house seat) and arena_join_queue (same queue under a clearer name). Queues you for an open partner; matches immediately if someone is waiting, else returns a queue_id — then arena_queue_wait. Optional peer_handle = named challenge (same rules as arena_join_queue). Credit: Dead Brands. Example: {"game":"asteroid_dodge","mode":"open"}
